answer: Training-data provenance checks stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent publishes a signed hash of its training data and weights, so copies share one fingerprint. Second, peers sample outputs monthly and test them against the declared model. Third, a mismatch freezes paid work and forfeits a $30 bond. Fourth, provenance renews yearly with fresh proof. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 training runs at $2,000 each plus $30,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is pigment in a harbor at dawn: real color holds in morning light, like a baker whose bread tastes the same daily.
